programme.title: Ngwana Wa Tshwenya
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Bonolo'. At 15, Bonolo is spiralling into a dangerous world of hook-ups, disappearances and older men, offering money in exchange for her innocence.

programme.title: Tseleng
programme.desc: 'S3/E6 - Juliet & Fikile'. Witness people with spiritual divination as we profile three mediums with different spiritual gifts. Connecting with ancestors, the mediums pick up random people and relays the messages.

programme.title: Sugar Mamas Jhb
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Surprise Visit'. During her powerful church service, Mamfundisi faces a shocking public confrontation, while Khethi struggles with a heartbreaking personal loss that shakes her faith and strength.

programme.title: Sbari Makoti
programme.desc: 'S2/E13 - Bonakele'. A compelling show that delves into family dynamics where a domineering son-in-law takes control within his wife's family home.

programme.title: Fake Gobela
programme.desc: 'S4/E6'. Gogo Mathambo is on a quest to find justice for sangomas who want to expose rogue gobelas who mistreat their initiates.

programme.title: X-Repo
programme.desc: 'S17/E67 - Thomas Maluleke'. X helps people who have been wronged on a personal level. He'll get your belongings back if you have proof that you are the rightful owner.

programme.title: Vimba
programme.desc: 'S2/E8'. A crime investigation television show that aims to clean up our streets by tackling various crime syndicates and criminal activists.

programme.title: Sizok'thola
programme.desc: 'S5/E8 - Brakpan cartels'. Crime is devastating South African communities. Sizokuthola investigates crimes, and tracks, and traces criminals in partnership with law enforcement agencies ensuring that criminals are brought to book.

programme.title: You Promised To Marry Me
programme.desc: 'S4/E4 - Kenalemang'. Everyone needs to know where they stand in a relationship. You Promised To Marry Me, is about the people who feel betrayed by their partners to honour or fulfil their promise of marrying them.

programme.title: Thokoza Gogo
programme.desc: 'S1/E11'. A reality show following a popular sangoma, Maweni, an ambitious entrepreneur, as she balances motherhood, marriage, and her personal life.

programme.title: Ishushu
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Nqobile and Mbhekeni'. Two boys from the hood who claim to know how to cook have to show us their cooking skills and it doesn't go as anticipated by the judge.

programme.title: Highly Inappropriate With Phat Joe
programme.desc: 'S1/E10'. A variety show that celebrates South Africa. The show takes a humorous standpoint on recent topical events that are not limited to current affairs, news, music, and tabloid.

programme.title: Hope
programme.desc: 'S1/E27'. Pastor Zakes runs a struggling church in downtown Johannesburg, plagued by financial problems. A rival church down the road steals its members.

programme.title: Finding Bongani Fassie
programme.desc: 'S1/E9'. Bongani Fassie navigates life after his mother's death - stolen estates and lost millions. A journey to discover the answers in his life.

programme.title: Coming Out
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Renay'. People of different sexual orientations get to tell their loved ones their true sexuality.

programme.title: Ke Nako
programme.desc: 'S1/E69'. A fun-filled TV drama/soap series exploding with drama, corruption, tragedy, romance and betrayal.

programme.title: Direct Flight
programme.desc: 'S1/E7'. A travel and lifestyle reality series that follows individuals as they embark on journeys that transform their lives.

programme.title: Umphakathi
programme.desc: 'S6/E19 - Young People Doing Amazing Things Within Communities'. The show will serve as a voice for black communities as we try to get to the root of some of the problems they are faced with and also try to find solutions.

programme.title: Ke Nako
programme.desc: 'S1/E32'. A fun-filled TV drama/soap series exploding with drama, corruption, tragedy, romance and betrayal.

programme.title: TMI
programme.desc: 'S1/E21'. Join Phil and Gabisile on our brand new show as they unpack and give you clarity on some of the biggest stories making headlines in entertainment.

programme.title: Hope
programme.desc: 'S1/E58'. Pastor Zakes runs a struggling church in downtown Johannesburg, plagued by financial problems. A rival church down the road steals its members.

programme.title: Judge Khambule
programme.desc: 'S1/E11'. Titular judge Thenjiwe Moseley presides over comedic cases inspired by real-life cases.

programme.title: Boss Ladies
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Family Bonds'. A reality show that profiles the lives of four black successful females who are redefining what it means to be a black businesswoman in the new Free State.

programme.title: Village Girls
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. The Phasha sisters share their journey as young women from rural Limpopo to their urban lifestyles as well-to-do entrepreneurs and social butterflies.

programme.title: Judge Khambule
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Titular judge Thenjiwe Moseley presides over comedic cases inspired by real-life cases.

programme.title: Kasi-2-Kasi
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Tshepo 'Jeans' Mohlala'. We follow well-known South African personalities from various fields as they take us on a tour of their favourite spots in the townships they grew up in.

programme.title: Unzima Umshado
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Gugulethu'. Marriages are falling apart out there. Sometimes all it takes to avoid divorce is communication. Who better to facilitate the conversation than TV and radio personality - Linda Sibiya.

programme.title: Madi Aka

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: A riveting action comedy. A realtor is pulled back into his old life by his former partner-in-crime. With his crime-lord brother also on his trail, he must confront his past.

programme.title: Freaky - Este Corpo Fica-Me A Matar
programme.desc: Vince Vaughn and Kathryn Newton play a game of cat and mouse in this slasher comedy. After a girl swaps bodies with a serial killer, she has less than 24 hours to change back.

programme.title: Medieval
programme.desc: Starring Ben Foster and Michael Caine, this is an epic take on the true story of Jan ika, one of Czech history's greatest warriors, who is said to have never lost a battle.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: Five Fingers For Marseilles
programme.desc: Lives change forever when Tau, the young lion, kills two corrupt policemen in a South African shanty town.

programme.title: The Day We Didn't Meet
programme.desc: A great South African film. Alex and Sam reconnect after a chance encounter. They imagine a fantasy life together and abandon all their responsibilities. However, reality sets in.

programme.title: One Life
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins leads this true story of bravery. A London broker helps save hundreds of predominantly Jewish children from the Nazis just before the start of WWII.

programme.title: Spud
programme.desc: Based on the South African best-seller, this insightful and funny coming-of-age film looks at a young boy's journey into manhood that begins in the halls of boarding school.

programme.title: Dog
programme.desc: Channing Tatum drives this heartfelt drama. A former Army Ranger and a military dog are paired against their will on the road trip to a fellow soldier's funeral.

programme.title: Richard The Stork 2
programme.desc: Richard, the daring sparrow who was adopted by a stork family, is back for another adventure. He embarks on a solo journey when he realises he won't be his flock's leader.

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Family Business
programme.desc: Now adults, estranged brothers Tim and Ted must work together again on a Baby Corp mission to defeat a new villain. Features the voices of Alec Baldwin, Eva Longoria and James Marsden.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: Get ready for some good, wholesome fun in this animated joyride. A rookie race car driver gets the opportunity to rally along the famous Silk Road trade route.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Excellent performances and great music turn this movie into a smash hit. A new recruit helps transform an all-girl singing group's sound, leading them to take on a boy band.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: An action thriller piloted by Gerard Butler. A pilot saves his passengers from a storm by landing on a war-torn island, putting all of them in the path of dangerous rebels.

programme.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
programme.desc: Henry Golding and Andrew Koji drive this action-packed G.I. Joe spin-off. A tenacious loner is welcomed into an ancient Japanese clan, but his honour and loyalty are tested.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: In this psychological horror with dark humour, singer Brandy Norwood finds herself facing a mother-in-law from hell when a pregnant couple takes in the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: 31 Million Reasons
programme.desc: Brothers Ronnie and Jugs are two Chatsworth policemen who hatch a plot to seize 31 million rands from a cash deposit facility.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Jenna Ortega and Martin Freeman are entangled in a complex situation in this thriller about a teacher-student relationship that unravels through a special writing project.

programme.title: Killing Field
